title: AEE Real Screen Reader Comparison
description: What AEE's virtual screen reader and one real screen reader (NVDA, VoiceOver or Orca, driven by Guidepup) said on the same page, written by `npm run readers:compare` as comparison.json, with how the real reader ran: the machine, the browser, the reader and its settings, the commands it was given and the retries it was allowed.

page.description: The page both readers read: a file in the repository or a URL.

environment.description: The machine and browser both readers ran on.

release.description: Node's `os.release()`: the operating system's own version.

guidepup.description: The version of `@guidepup/guidepup` that drove the real reader.

speechEngine.description: What decides what AEE's virtual reader says: Guidepup's virtual screen reader, and its version.

osImage.description: The GitHub runner image, from its `ImageOS` variable (such as `win25`).

osImageVersion.description: The runner image's version, from its `ImageVersion` variable.

browser.description: The browser Playwright ran, by Playwright's name for it.

osLocale.description: The operating system's locale, as Node's `Intl` reads it.

browserLocale.description: The browser's language (`navigator.language` on the page).

virtual.description: What AEE's virtual screen reader said, one announcement per step.

real.description: What the real screen reader said, why its walk ended, and how it ran.

readerVersion.description: The version the reader itself reports: NVDA's `nvda.exe`, VoiceOver's app bundle.

readerBuild.description: Guidepup's `screenReader.version`: the build of the reader, or of its settings, that Guidepup installed.

voice.description: The voice the reader spoke with.

verbosity.description: The reader's verbosity setting, where it has one.

punctuation.description: How much punctuation and how many symbols the reader speaks.

commands.description: Every Guidepup command sent to the reader during the walk, with how many times, in the order each was first sent.

attempt.description: Which attempt this was: a reader that fails to start is tried again.

retriesAllowed.description: How many retries the run allowed (Playwright's `--retries`).

repeatedAtEnd.description: What the reader said again at the end of the page, left out of `phrases`.

alignment.description: The two transcripts lined up, one row per thing on the page.

runDetail.description: A value read from where it is recorded, with where that is; or, when it could not be read, why. Never a guess.

unknown.description: Why the value could not be read.

command.description: The Guidepup command, by its name and options.

walkEnd.description: Why the real reader's walk ended: it said nothing at the next step, it said the same thing three times in a row, or it reached `maxSteps`.
